hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Hint: graphify-out/graph.json exists. If the question is about architecture or cross-file relationships, `graphify query \"<question>\"` may answer it in one step instead of several greps. If you already know what string to look for, grep directly - an extra orientation step costs about as much as the grep it precedes."}}'   || true ;; esac
